reset_world_state: reset the World class to reinitialize all cached objects and regions when the scene changes
update_world_state: update the World state machine every frame by calling update with the delta time
get_state_snapshot_dict: get a snapshot dictionary of all object states like is_powered_on and is_clean
get_states_for_object_handle: get all object states and their values for a given object handle string
get_all_states: get a map of all active object state specifications with state names as keys
